title: Score rewards looking right before being right
explanation: The reward gives high score for a polished answer before checking the real-world rule. Training will discover that shortcut.
suggested_patch: Make the real-world rule a hard gate before style or speed points.

title: Human-intent check is not part of the training score
explanation: The demo has a clear human rule, but the old reward does not enforce it.
suggested_patch: Add the human rule to the reward.
